clips.text: Finally he bowed and left to meditate on the problem.
The next night he returned and struck the gong with one palm.
That is not right, said the master.
The next night Toyo returned and played geisha music with one hand That is not right, said the master.
Again and again Toyo returned with some answer but the master said again and again, That is not right.
For nights Toyo tried new sounds but each and every answer was rejected.
The question itself was absurd so no answer could be right.
When Toyo came on the eleventh night, before he said anything the master said: That is still not right! - then he stopped coming to the master.
For a year he thought of every possible sound and discarded them all, and when there was nothing left to be discarded any more he exploded into enlightenment.
